steps.help: The chain in order, each entry described individually under keys. The side (va or nva) is the vertical position of the card; it does not affect the position in the chain.

title.help: The title of the step, a short name for the activity.

description.help: The description of the step, free text.

side.help: The band of the step: va for value-added (upper band), nva for non-value-added (lower band: rework, waiting, inspecting).

va.help: Upper band: value-added steps (VA) the customer pays for.

nva.help: Lower band: non-value-added steps (NVA) — rework, waiting, inspecting, correcting.

substeps.help: The sub-steps of the step in order, each entry described under keys.

addStep.help: Inserts an empty step into the chain and returns its id.

params.side: Column the new step lands in: 'va' value-added or 'nva' rework.
params.index: Position of the new step in the chain after insertion (0 = very front, the number of steps = at the end). Omit to append at the end. A value outside this range or a non-integer is an error.

removeStep.help: Removes a step together with its sub-steps from the chain.

params.id: The id of the step to remove. An unknown id is an error.

moveStep.help: Moves a step to another place in the chain and, if wanted, sets its column at the same time.

params.id: The id of the step to move. An unknown id is an error.
params.index: The position of the step after the move, an integer from 0 (very front) to the number of steps minus one.
params.side: Optional: the step's new column, 'va' value-added or 'nva' rework. Omit to keep the column.

setSide.help: Sets a step's column; its position in the chain stays.

params.id: The id of the step. An unknown id is an error.
params.side: Column of the step: 'va' value-added or 'nva' rework. A value outside this set is an error.

addSubstep.help: Adds an empty sub-step to a step. Returns the id of the new sub-step.

params.stepId: The id of the step that receives the new sub-step. An unknown id is an error.

removeSubstep.help: Removes a sub-step from its parent step.

params.stepId: The id of the parent step. An unknown id is an error.
params.substepId: The id of the sub-step to remove. An unknown id is an error.

moveSubstep.help: Moves a sub-step to another position within its step.

params.stepId: The id of the step the sub-step belongs to. An unknown id is an error.
params.substepId: The id of the sub-step to move. An unknown id is an error.
params.index: The position of the sub-step after the move, an integer from 0.

setExpanded.help: Shows or hides a step's sub-steps; presentation only, the content stays.

params.id: The id of the step whose sub-steps are shown or hidden. An unknown id is an error.
params.expanded: true shows the sub-steps, false hides them.

appendSteps.help: Appends several steps to the end of the chain, for example taken over from another instance. Returns the number of appended steps.

params.steps: The steps to append as a list; each entry has title, description and side ('va' or 'nva').
